S6_running_floor.claim: In the periodic (axion-monodromy) completion, the coupling c' = -d ln m_DM/dphi obeys dc'/dphi >= 2 c'^2, so c' grows toward today by at least 2 c' Delta_phi (about 3 percent for the c<0 mode, 8-9 percent for c>0) between recombination and today, for any F.
S6_running_floor.falsified_if: data prefer a decreasing c' (c'_1 < 0) at more than 2 sigma, or the minimal-running monodromy model (F -> infinity) fits worse than constant c' by Delta chi2 > 4 after refitting
S6_running_floor.scored_by: a fit with c'(phi) free to run (e.g. c'(phi) = c'_0 + c'_1 phi) to Planck/ACT + DESI + SN + lensing + shear, and the mono_fit.py refits
